skills.name: figma-use
skills.purpose: Foundation skill for writing to the Figma canvas through the MCP `use_figma` tool: Plugin API rules, node creation and editing, variables, components and auto layout.
skills.how_to_use: Install Figma's own Claude Code plugin from figma/mcp-server-guide (`claude plugin install figma@claude-plugins-official`), which sets up the remote Figma MCP server (https://mcp.figma.com/mcp) and bundles this skill. Load before any `use_figma` call (create/edit nodes, variables, components).
skills.evidence: Official Figma; skills.sh ~7.9k installs; also mirrored in openai/skills (2.7k installs). Found in soorajplankuveedu/claude-knowledge-backup on 3 Oct 2026.
skills.notes: Governed by the Figma Developer Terms (no open-source licence file); link-only. Beta feature.
